nav.taxesHint: VAT and other taxes, with the exemption for foreign non-residents.
nav.extrasHint: Breakfast, parking, transfers and other services charged separately.

grid.title: Rates
grid.description: Price, minimum stay and restrictions of every night. Type over a cell to change it.
grid.label: Nightly rates · {{plan}}
grid.invalidPrice: Type the price in pesos, without decimals (for example 320.000).
grid.invalidMinLos: The minimum stay goes from 1 to 365 nights. Leave it empty to remove it.
grid.derivedNotice: This plan is calculated from {{parent}} ({{rule}}): its prices follow on their own. To change them, edit the base plan.
grid.noPlans: There are no rate plans yet
grid.noPlansHint: Create a base plan with the price of each room type to see the rate grid here.
grid.noRoomTypes: This plan sells no room types
grid.noRoomTypesHint: Choose which room types the plan sells so you can price them.

undo.hint: Undoes the last edit of the grid
undo.empty: You have not edited the grid yet
undo.unavailable: Undo will be available once the audit history of the control center is enabled.

plans.title: Rate plans
plans.description: How every price is built: base plans hold the price of each room type, derived plans follow them on their own and seasons change them between two dates.

families.intro: Default price of a weeknight. Weekday adjustments, seasons and the grid change it night by night; derived plans always follow it.
families.emptyHint: Create a base plan with the price of each room type, then add derived plans such as non-refundable or breakfast included.
families.tableLabel: Prices of {{plan}} and its derived plans
families.noRoomTypes: This plan sells no room type. Edit it to pick them.

editor.baseHint: A base plan has its own price per room type: set it in Default prices and on the grid.
editor.derivedHint: A derived plan has no price of its own: it comes from its base plan by a percentage or an amount and changes when the base changes.
editor.percentHint: Negative for a discount: -12 lowers the price by 12 %.
editor.amountHint: Negative for a discount: -20000 lowers each night by $ 20,000.
editor.discountTooBig: A discount can't be more than 100 %.
editor.roomTypesDerivedHint: It can only sell room types of its base plan.
editor.roomTypesEmpty: Without room types the plan can't be sold.
editor.depositHint: Share of the total requested to guarantee the booking.
editor.minLosHint: Nights. The grid can set another one night by night.
editor.publicHint: When off, it is sold only at the front desk (for example, corporate rates).
editor.allChannelsHint: Turn it off to sell it on some channels only.
editor.channelsRequired: Pick at least one channel or sell on all of them.
editor.activeHint: An inactive plan is not offered on any channel.

adjustments.label: Adjustment by day of the week (%)
adjustments.hint: Applies to that day's night. Empty or 0: no adjustment.

defaults.intro: What each room type costs when there is no season or manual price on the grid. Derived plans start from here.
defaults.extraChildHint: For each child up to the age limit; older children pay as adults.
defaults.singleHint: Optional: price for a guest alone. On seasons and manual prices it scales by the same proportion.
defaults.missingHint: No default price: this room type is not sold on nights without a manual or season price.
defaults.dialogHint: {{plan}}: what a night costs when there is no season or manual price.
defaults.dormHint: Dorms are sold by the bed: no extra-person charges and no single-guest price.

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.emptyHint: Create seasons such as year-end or Holy Week to raise prices on those dates.
seasons.dialogHint: From the first to the last night, each room type uses its season price instead of the default price.
seasons.lastNightHint: Included: that night also uses the season price.
seasons.rangeInvalid: The last night can't be before the first one.
seasons.priorityHint: When two seasons overlap, the higher priority wins.
seasons.priorityInvalid: Enter a whole number, for example 10.
seasons.pricesHint: Room types without a season price keep charging their default price.
seasons.noBasePlan: Create a base plan to price the seasons.
seasons.computeHint: Creates or replaces the season price of every room type with a default price, keeping its weekday adjustments.
seasons.computed_one: Season price computed for {{count}} room type
seasons.computed_other: Season prices computed for {{count}} room types
seasons.missingDefaults_one: {{names}} has no default price: set one first.
seasons.missingDefaults_other: {{names}} have no default price: set them first.

bulk.title: Bulk edit
bulk.description: Change many nights and room types of the {{plan}} plan at once.
bulk.nightsHint: Includes the first and the last night.
bulk.percent: Raise or lower by a percentage
bulk.amount: Raise or lower by an amount
bulk.signedHint: Use a negative number to lower it.
bulk.needRoomType: Choose at least one room type.
bulk.needWeekday: Choose at least one day of the week.
bulk.needDates: Choose the first and the last night.
bulk.needPrice: Type the new price or the adjustment.
bulk.needStay: Minimum and maximum stay go from 1 to 365 nights.

crud.deleteHint: This cannot be undone. If it is in use, deactivate it instead.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.description: Taxes added to or included in rates and extras. Lodging VAT is not charged to foreign non-residents (Colombian Tax Code art. 481).
taxes.dialogHint: Applied in quotes and in folio charges.
taxes.includedHint: The published price already contains it; quotes show it for information.
taxes.exemptHint: Hotel services to non-residents (Tax Code art. 481 lit. d).
taxes.emptyHint: Create VAT so quotes include it.

policies.title: Cancellation policies
policies.description: Until when guests can cancel for free and what is charged afterwards. Each rate plan uses one policy.
policies.dialogHint: Each reservation keeps a copy of the policy in force when it was booked.
policies.nonRefundableHint: The full stay is charged on any cancellation.
policies.hoursHint: Counted from the check-in time of the arrival day.
policies.hoursInvalid: Type a number of hours (0 or more).
policies.emptyHint: Create at least one flexible and one non-refundable policy.

extras.title: Extras
extras.description: Services charged apart from the room. They go to the folio and, when sold online, to the booking engine and the marketplace.
extras.dialogHint: The price is net; tax is calculated separately.
extras.onlineHint: Shown in the booking engine, the marketplace and the guest portal.
extras.emptyHint: Add breakfast, parking or transfers to offer them with the reservation.

promos.title: Promo codes
promos.description: Discounts guests type when they book on the booking engine, the marketplace or at the front desk.
promos.dialogHint: The discount applies to every night that falls inside the code's stay dates.
promos.codeHint: What the guest types: letters, numbers and dashes, no spaces.
promos.codeInvalid: Use 2 to 40 letters, numbers, dashes or underscores.
promos.bookingWindowHint: Days when bookings can use the code. Empty: always.
promos.stayWindowHint: Only nights inside these dates get the discount. Empty: any night.
promos.rangeInvalid: The end date can't be before the start date.
promos.allPlansHint: With none checked, the code works on every rate plan.
promos.maxUsesHint: Each booking made with the code counts one use. Empty: no limit.
promos.maxUsesInvalid: Enter a whole number above zero or leave it empty.
promos.activeHint: Turn it off to pause the code without deleting it.
promos.emptyHint: Create a code like WELCOME10 to reward guests who book direct.

quote.title: Try a quote
quote.description: Works out what a guest would pay with today's rules: nightly price, occupancy, promo, restrictions and taxes. It doesn't book anything.
quote.agesHint: Comma separated. Children above the room type's age limit pay as adults; without an age they count as children.
quote.foreignHint: Exempt from lodging VAT (Tax Statute art. 481).
quote.needStay: Pick a plan, a room type and dates.
quote.agesInvalid: Ages go from 0 to 17, one per child.
quote.notSellable: It can't be sold under these conditions

violations.stop_sell: One of the nights is closed for sale.
violations.cta: The arrival day is closed to arrivals.
violations.ctd: The departure day is closed to departures.
violations.min_los: The stay is shorter than the minimum stay of the arrival night.
violations.max_los: The stay is longer than the maximum stay of the arrival night.
violations.no_rate: Some nights have no price set: they can't be booked until they do.
violations.promo_invalid: The promo code doesn't apply to this stay (it doesn't block the sale).
